import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = r"\b(a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP)\s*<-\s*(a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP|\d+)\b"

for target, source in re.findall(pattern, text):
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
